snippet.title: Zero-G Alpha 5.0.0 — The Auction House Opens | Persistent Browser Space MMO
snippet.description:
Alpha 5.0.0 is live. After four months of public alpha, the first real player-driven economy in Zero-G just launched.

🏛️ THE AUCTION HOUSE IS OPEN
At Grottaglie HQ, pilots can now place buy orders, sell orders, and bids directly with each other. Prices are set by supply and demand between real pilots — not by the game. Everything mined, scanned, and hauled since January now has real market value.

⚙️ CRAFTING PHASE 0.5
The industrial foundation is live. Raw ore becomes refined elements, refined elements become components. The full refining loop goes live in the coming days.

🚀 FOUR NEW SHIPS
Falco Alpha — replaces the Alpha-Scout. Double cargo, better engines, combat capable.
Vespera Alpha — fast explorer, free pilot's Vanguard equivalent. No premium currency required.
Prospero Alpha — new miner. Better cargo, speed, armor.
Caronte Alpha — new hauler. Significantly faster than its predecessor.

⚔️ COMBAT MISSIONS LIVE
Full ship stats visible before committing to battle. Loot box tracking from the Combat menu. Daily missions completely retuned for new players.
🎖️ BULLA MARIANA — FIRST MONTHLY EXPEDITION
28 days, 15 Gradus from Novitiate to Chrysonaut. Gradus 1 gives every enrolling pilot a free Diamond Mining Tip. No purchase required.

Zero-G is a persistent single-shard browser MMO built on real NASA orbital data. 1:1 scale solar system, Keplerian orbital mechanics, Tsiolkovsky rocket physics. No download. Free to play.
Public alpha since January 18, 2026 — 1,230+ registered pilots.

🔗 LINKS
▶ Play free (no download): https://space.zerog.live
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/C9dWFP2jJt
▶ Full release notes: https://space.zerog.live/newsletter/11
▶ IGDB: https://www.igdb.com/games/zero-g-mmo
▶ IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/project-zero-g
